provenance.source_title: Why It Sucks to Be a Harem Concubine in Ottoman Empire

examples.psychological_goal: 第一秒用'想象这个画面'把观众放进熟悉的看剧场景，零铺垫代入
examples.expression_mechanism: 祈使句开场 + 第二人称日常场景指派
examples.example_text: Picture this. You are watching a historical drama on television.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'想象这个画面+你正在做某件日常事'一句话完成低门槛沉浸
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该场景设定与媒介措辞

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话预告粉碎方向：幻想将被改写成官僚噩梦
examples.expression_mechanism: '历史总是把X变成Y'的转折句式 + 意外搭配的名词组合
examples.example_text: history always manages to take our wildest fantasies and turn them into a bureaucratic psychological nightmare.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在幻想铺陈后用一句拟人化转折宣布粉碎开始，名词组合要出人意料
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该句式中的具体意象与搭配

examples.psychological_goal: 用否定一个荒诞的现代画面来击碎浪漫滤镜，制造笑点
examples.expression_mechanism: '真实面貌不是[现代享乐场景]'的否定式定性
examples.example_text: The historical reality of the Ottoman herm was not a giant sexy pool party.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先用一个观众脑中的夸张画面做靶子，再以否定句当众拆掉
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该比喻；靶子画面必须来自目标观众的真实想象

examples.psychological_goal: 把'往上爬'的代价拆成三连恐怖清单，兑现标题的诉苦承诺
examples.expression_mechanism: 现代职场词 + 三项递进的禁忌行为清单
examples.example_text: breaking the glass ceiling usually involved bribing a guard, poisoning your best friend, and surviving the most toxic mother-in-law
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把现代晋升词汇嫁接到历史语境，再用三连动名词把代价具象化
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该清单内容；递进末项应落在最意外的亲属关系上

examples.psychological_goal: 用'要理解X必须回到起点'句式把叙事从钩子切换到正题
examples.expression_mechanism: 理解前置条件句式 + 管道隐喻
examples.example_text: To understand the sheer scale of the misery inside the herm, we have to start at the very beginning of the pipeline.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在开场钩子完成后用一句解释性转场进入背景段落，隐喻要与全片主类比一致
examples.negative_instruction: 不要机械套用该句式；转场必须指向观众仍惦记的问题

examples.psychological_goal: 用现代职位类比为陌生等级一秒定性，制造错位笑点
examples.expression_mechanism: [古代头衔] basically = the ancient equivalent of [现代职位]
examples.example_text: which is basically the ancient equivalent of an unpaid corporate intern.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在抛出陌生专名后立刻用'古代版某现代职位'完成翻译与祛魅
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该职位类比；类比必须准确映射权力与待遇

examples.psychological_goal: 用名校类比抬高预期，再用失败下场一句话砸落
examples.expression_mechanism: 崇高类比 + but条件句 + 荒诞下场的落差结构
examples.example_text: It was essentially an Ivy League university, but if you failed your final exams, you spent the rest of your life doing the Sultan's laundry.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给一个体面的现代类比，再用转折句揭示失败代价，落差即笑点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类比与下场；代价必须与主题逻辑相符

examples.psychological_goal: 用两句短断言完成权力反转：名义主人只是偶尔露面的客人
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定句架空 + 肯定句降格的连续打击
examples.example_text: The Sultan did not run the herm. The Sultan was basically just a VIP guest who occasionally showed up.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'X并不掌权，X只是个偶尔出现的贵宾'的否定-降格两步完成反转
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该身份与措辞；反转必须建立在前文铺垫的悬念上

examples.psychological_goal: 把多年努力换来的'浪漫奖赏'呈现为荒诞动作，制造幻灭笑点
examples.expression_mechanism: '你的浪漫回报是[屈辱动作]'的反讽句式
examples.example_text: your big romantic reward is having to army crawl across a Persian rug in total silence
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把崇高期待与卑微动作直接焊接，不加形容词让落差自己说话
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该动作与场景细节

examples.psychological_goal: 在观众以为尘埃落定时宣布类型切换：职场剧变恐怖片
examples.expression_mechanism: '正是在这一刻，X不再是A而变成B'的换挡句式
examples.example_text: this is exactly the moment where the Ottoman harum stops being a corporate ladder and turns into an absolute blood soaked horror movie
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'正是这一刻'锚定转折点，并以两种类型片名的对照宣布换挡
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类型对照；换挡必须发生在观众误判安全的顶点

examples.psychological_goal: 用条文式引述把中枢规则的冷酷合法性钉死
examples.expression_mechanism: 法律腔引语：legally required + 极端义务
examples.example_text: is legally required to execute every single one of his brothers and half brothers.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在揭示制度时直接引述条文腔措辞，'合法'与'暴行'的并置即冲击
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该条文内容；引述须服务于'制度性疯狂'的定性

examples.psychological_goal: 用否定排比把零和生存规则钉进记忆，制造窒息感
examples.expression_mechanism: There is no X. There is no Y. There is only A or B. 三连判词
examples.example_text: There is no second place. There is no runner-up prize. There is only the throne or the silk cord.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用两次否定排掉温和选项，再用'只有A或B'的意象对给出唯一结局
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该意象对；两个结局选项必须都是前文已建立的具象物

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个视觉画面兑现恐怖规模，让数字落地为创伤
examples.expression_mechanism: 精确数字 + 幼小化形容词 + 仪式感画面的白描
examples.example_text: 19 tiny custom-made wooden coffins were carried out of the top copy palace in a massive, deeply traumatic public procession.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在沉重段落撤掉调侃，用'数字+尺寸+仪式'的白描句让画面自己发力
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该数字与画面细节；沉重画面不可用俏皮语气

examples.psychological_goal: 用流行文化参照为'唯一赢家'定性，完成循环机制的揭示
examples.expression_mechanism: won + [流行文化生存竞赛] 的类比定性
examples.example_text: the only woman who actually won the Hunger Games was the mother of the new sultan.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用观众熟悉的生存竞赛IP为残酷的淘汰机制一秒定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该IP参照；类比必须共享'唯一胜者'的结构

examples.psychological_goal: 先替观众说出合理期待，再当众击碎，预告二次反转
examples.expression_mechanism: You would think X. You would think Y. But 定性句 的预期违背三连
examples.example_text: You would think this would make life in the Haram better. You would think the mothers could finally relax. But this is the Ottoman Empire
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用两次'你以为'复述观众的期待，再用一句转折定性宣布更糟
examples.negative_instruction: 不要机械套用；转折后的现实必须比前一个问题更糟

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个荒诞画面浓缩囚禁制度的后果：几十年不见天日的人被拖出来登基
examples.expression_mechanism: 动作白描 + 年龄与时间跨度的反差细节
examples.example_text: pull out a 50-year-old man who hadn't seen the sky in four decades.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'年龄数字+被剥夺的基本体验'的反差细节让制度后果具象化
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该数字与意象；反差必须直指制度的独特伤害

examples.psychological_goal: 用现代商业场景类比把破例的震撼换算成当代量级
examples.expression_mechanism: It was like a [现代权力场景] suddenly [荒诞对应动作]
examples.example_text: It was like a billionaire CEO suddenly announcing that he's legally signing over half his company to the unpaid summer intern.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'就像某富豪突然把半个公司签给实习生'式类比传达礼制冲击的量级
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类比双方的身份设定；类比两端必须与全片职场隐喻一致

examples.psychological_goal: 用二选一判词粉碎例外者神话，完成全片世界观收束
examples.expression_mechanism: either predator or prey 二元判词 + 否定中间地带
examples.example_text: you were either the predator or you were the prey. There was no middle ground.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在例外者故事末尾用二元判词反转其神话：不是打破系统，而是成为最狠的玩家
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该二元意象；判词必须回应前文建立的体制逻辑

examples.psychological_goal: 把全片苦难映射回观众的现代日常，用一句对照金句完成释然收束
examples.expression_mechanism: 让步承认 + but转折 + 日常场景与历史恐怖的并置
examples.example_text: Modern corporate culture is definitely a soul crushing grind, but at least your quarterly performance review doesn't involve testing your lunch for cyanide.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾先承认观众现实的苦，再用'至少你不用面对X'的历史恐怖对照制造黑色幽默式感恩
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该对照内容；对照项必须是全片已建立的恐怖细节
